caption: The drawing features a single shoe predominantly placed in the bottom right quadrant of the image. The shoe has a pointed toe and a small, slightly flared heel. It is covered in a plaid pattern featuring horizontal and vertical stripes in yellow, blue, and black against a cream background. There is also a small bow or ribbon attached to the side near the opening of the shoe. In the upper left area of the image, there are two simple outline sketches of the shoe from a top and side view, drawn in pencil without any color or shading. The background is plain and a light beige color, with no additional objects or decorations.
title: Slipper
